title: MDF analysis of ethanol production pathways in thermophilic anaerobes
description:
Max-min Driving Force (MDF) analysis of alternative glucose-to-ethanol pathways in Clostridium thermocellum and Thermoanaerobacterium saccharolyticum, evaluated at high ethanol titer. Fifteen stoichiometrically balanced flux modes are compared, differing in how electrons are transferred from reduced ferredoxin to NAD(P) and in the cofactor specificity of the aldehyde and alcohol dehydrogenase steps.

The repository contains the pathway model, the analysis code, and the generated SBtab models, figures and summary tables. Package versions are pinned and every reported value is regenerated with a single command.
